facts.fact: The Bank of the Republic of Burundi's circular of 29 May 2020 sets sanctions for breaches of Regulation 001/2019 on consumer protection for financial products and services, whose breach categories include digital financial services.
facts.system: Circulaire N° 01/2020 (sanctions matrix under Règlement N° 001/2019)

facts.fact: The circular's sanctions matrix requires providers to notify complainants in writing that they may appeal to the central bank and to send the BRB quarterly reports on consumer complaints.
facts.system: Circulaire N° 01/2020 (sanctions matrix under Règlement N° 001/2019)

systems.system: Circulaire N° 01/2020 (sanctions matrix under Règlement N° 001/2019)
systems.owner: Banque de la République du Burundi

BDI.note: Matrix sets penalties; no fine actually imposed is reported.
